scope: Every provision of the Act as in the PCO's version as at 1 July 2026 (ss 1-77, Schedule 1AA, Schedule 1), from the text converted from the PCO XML. Inputs: employee and spouse status; the s 7 facts; average hours with the same employer over 6 and 12 months (after s 72A, Schedule 1); weekly hours and earnings over 52 weeks; ordinary weekly pay and self-employed income; the maximum weekly rate in force and the minimum wage; the day the 36th week would end; agreements, consents, employer defences and determinations. Carried as text: the provisions in `provisions carried as text`. Refused: children due, born or taken into care before 1 July 2020 (Schedule 1AA cl 5).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-15 (tests-independent.l4, 264 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read). It found 12 disagreements now resolved in its favour (s 7(2), the s 2BA(4) 26 weeks, s 6 for all leave and measured to the start, s 71D(2)(b), s 54, fractional preterm weeks); the encoder's tests encoding the rejected readings were changed and marked. 2 assertions still fail by design: notice deadlines counted by date difference against clear days (fork F3). The pipeline has not been run. On 2026-10-17, at the user's direction, Legislation Act 2019 s 55 was applied to the deadlines to decide or challenge a flexible-leave request (ss 30D, 30I), to apply for parental leave payments (s 71I), to file a charge (s 71Z), to apply for a review (s 71ZB), to act within n days after an event (ss 34, 36, 38), to apply for an interim order (s 55), to complain (s 70) and to object (s 70C) — not deadlines counted back from an event; 4 independent assertion(s) written before that change now fail by design.

forks.F1: ss 26(3), 28(1): a person's own extended leave is reduced by their own primary carer leave; the shared pool by both people's.
forks.F2: s 27(3): the 12-month end date applies where either partner meets the 12-month test.
forks.F3: ss 30B(3)(c), 33(b), 37, 39(2): 'at least' and 'not less than' a number of days are clear days.
forks.F4: ss 6, 71F: the 6 months are measured to the start of the new leave or payments.
forks.F5: s 71M(1B): a person eligible as employee and self-employed receives both rates added, up to the maximum.
forks.F6: s 71DA(2): preterm baby payment for the exact weeks, part weeks as fractions.
forks.F7: s 2BA(4): employment in 26 of the 52 weeks, averaging 10 hours over 26 of them.
forks.S55: Legislation Act 2019 s 55 (applied 2026-10-17 at the user's direction): the deadlines to decide or challenge a flexible-leave request (ss 30D, 30I), to apply for parental leave payments (s 71I), to file a charge (s 71Z), to apply for a review (s 71ZB), to act within n days after an event (ss 34, 36, 38), to apply for an interim order (s 55), to complain (s 70) and to object (s 70C) — not deadlines counted back from an event run to the next working day (Legislation Act s 13, with the Matariki dates in Schedule 1 of the Te Kāhui o Matariki Public Holiday Act 2022) when they end on a non-working day.
